candidate_rules_in_order: For one-line JSON objects, emit each non-empty top-level string field in source order.
Otherwise, emit one non-empty key=value or key:value assignment with an identifier-like key.
Trim assignment value whitespace, remove one matching outer quote pair, and remove a whitespace-delimited trailing # or // comment outside quotes.
folder_label_rule: Corpus annotations are carried into extraction results for training/evaluation only; they are never target-scan predictions.
future_handoff: A later versioned classifier-input contract will map extracted records to canonical preprocessing without changing input-001.
